item.title: Yoo Young-ha: "Park Geun-hye, like King Danjong's restoration... The phrase 'Lass, I am the plum blossom' lingers in my mind" (유영하 “박근혜, 단종처럼 복위…‘소녀, 매화이옵니다’ 입에 맴돈다”)
item.description:
Yoo Young-ha, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, claimed about former President Park Geun-hye that "just like King Danjong, who was restored from Prince Nosan, the yoke of lies and slander placed upon her will surely be removed, and she will be restored to her rightful place." Representative Yoo is one of Park's closest confidants. (유영하 국민의힘 의원이 박근혜 전 대통령을 두고 “노산군에서 복위된 단종처럼 거짓과 모함으로 덧씌워진 멍에는 반드시 벗겨지고 제 자리로 복위될 것”이라고 주장했다. 유 의원은 박 전 대통령의 최측근이다.)

In a Facebook post on the 1st, Rep. Yoo said, "Truth cannot be confined or hidden," adding this statement. He also said that "restoration" is "the last mission left for me" and that "even if it's slow, I must go on without giving up until the end." (유 의원은 1일 페이스북에 “진실은 가둬지지 않고 숨겨지지도 않는다”며 이렇게 말했다. 유 의원은 ‘복위’가 “내게 남은 마지막 소명”이라며 “더디더라도 끝까지 포기하지 않고 가야만 한다”고도 했다.)

Referring to his campaign rally support for Choo Kyung-ho, the People Power Party's mayoral candidate in Daegu, alongside former President Park at places like Seomun Market in Daegu the previous day, Rep. Yoo said, "I also felt just as sorry, having to inevitably block the hands that reached out with all their might just to touch her hand once." (유 의원은 전날 박 전 대통령과 대구 서문시장 등을 돌며 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보 지원 유세를 한 것을 언급하며 “(박 전 대통령의) 손 한 번 만져보기 위해서 있는 힘을 다해 뻗는 손들을 어쩔 수 없이 막아내야 했던 나도 안쓰럽기는 매한가지”라고 말했다.)

Rep. Yoo stated, "Even today, her hands are grabbed, and she is pulled by the shoulder, causing her pain. As soon as she arrived at her private residence, she received emergency treatment, and I could only tell her to rest starting tomorrow. Yesterday, she endured with an IV drip, but now all her energy must be exhausted." He added, "I felt that the shouts of so many people we saw today were an expression of regret for not being able to protect the president." (유 의원은 “(박 전 대통령은) 오늘도 손이 잡히고, 어깨까지 잡아당겨져서 통증이 있다고 하신다. 사저에 도착하시자마자 응급치료를 하시고 내일부터 안정을 취하시라는 말씀밖에 달리 드릴 말씀이 없었다”며 “어제도 링거를 맞고 버티셨는데 이젠 모든 에너지가 소진되셨을 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “오늘 보여준 그 많은 분들의 외침은 대통령님을 지켜주지 못했다는 미안함이라고 나는 느꼈다”고 말했다.)

Rep. Yoo added, "Those who subjected her to public humiliation and danced a cruel knife dance, committing character assassination, will surely pay the price, and that day is not far off." (유 의원은 “그대들이 했던 조리돌림과 잔인한 칼춤을 추면서 자행했던 인격 살인에 대한 대가는 꼭 받을 것이고, 그날이 멀지 않았다”고 덧붙였다.)

On the 28th of last month, Rep. Yoo also said on Facebook, "When President Park Chung-hee passed away, I saw the plum tree of loyalty at Cheongungak, which shed two petals and then withered. It makes me wonder if it's a coincidence that the court lady who remained loyal to King Danjong until the end in the hottest recent movie, 'The Man Who Lives with the King,' is named Maehwa (Plum Blossom)." Rep. Yoo added, "Loyalty remains unchanged through the ages," and "The line 'Lass, I am the plum blossom' lingers around my lips." (유 의원은 지난달 28일에도 페이스북에서 “박정희 대통령께서 서거하셨을 때 꽃잎 두 잎을 피운 후 고사한, 청운각 충절의 매화나무를 보면서 최근 가장 핫한 영화인 ‘왕과 사는 남자’에서 단종의 마지막까지 지킨 궁녀 이름이 매화인 것이 우연인가 싶다”고 말하기도 했다. 유 의원은 “충절은 시대를 지나도 그 뜻은 변하지 않는다”며 “‘소녀, 매화이옵니다’라는 대사가 입 주위를 맴돈다”고 했다.)

Former President Park was sentenced by the Supreme Court to 22 years in prison, a fine of 18 billion won, and an additional penalty of 3.5 billion won for charges including the "confidante power abuse" scandal and illegally receiving special activity funds from the National Intelligence Service. She served 4 years and 9 months before being released in December 2021 through a special pardon by former President Moon Jae-in. Starting from Daegu on the 23rd, former President Park has been touring nationwide, including Daejeon and Okcheon and Gongju in North Chungcheong Province (25th), Jinju in South Gyeongsang Province, Ulsan, and Busan (27th), Wonju in Gangwon Province (28th), and Changwon and Namhae in South Gyeongsang Province (29th), conducting campaign support at the "election committee chairperson level" for the People Power Party. This marks the first time former President Park has appeared at campaign rally sites since being impeached from the presidency in 2017. (박 전 대통령은 비선 실세 국정농단 사건과 국가정보원 특수활동비 상납 등의 혐의로 징역 22년과 벌금 180억원, 추징금 35억원이 대법원에서 확정돼 4년9개월간 복역하다가 문재인 전 대통령의 특별사면으로 2021년 12월 풀려났다. 박 전 대통령은 지난 23일 대구를 시작으로, 대전, 충북 옥천·공주(25일), 경남 진주, 울산, 부산(27일), 강원 원주(28일), 경남 창원·남해(29일) 등 전국을 두루 돌며 국민의힘 ‘선거대책위원장급’ 지원 유세를 벌이고 있다. 박 전 대통령이 선거 유세 현장에 모습을 보인 것은 2017년 대통령직에서 탄핵당한 이후 이번이 처음이다.)

Song Kyung-hwa, Reporter freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Jae-myung on 'KOSPI 4100 Excluding Semiconductors' Controversy: "Why Exclude a Core Industry? It's Actually Amazing" (이재명, ‘반도체 제외 4100’ 논란에 “왜 핵심 산업 빼나…오히려 대단”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 1st shared an article stating that if semiconductors are excluded, the KOSPI index would be 4100, and said, "Semiconductors are one of the core industries of our country, so I don't quite understand why we need to calculate the composite stock index excluding them." (이재명 대통령이 1일 반도체를 빼면 코스피 지수가 4100이라는 기사를 공유하며 “반도체가 우리 산업의 핵심 중 하나인데 왜 반도체를 빼고 종합주가지수를 계산해야 하는지 이해가 잘 안 된다”고 말했다.)

On that day, President Lee shared an article on X (formerly Twitter) with the headline 'Market in Illusion... If You Exclude Semiconductors, KOSPI Barely at 4100.' The article reported that an analysis showed the actual KOSPI index, excluding semiconductor sectors like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, only stood at 4100-4200. In response, President Lee said, "'If you take away his soccer skills, Son Heung-min is just an ordinary person?' No one says that. Rather, 'Even excluding semiconductors, the Korean stock market is still at 4100—shouldn't that be the focus?'" <<> Meanwhile, the KOSPI index surged during the day, breaking through the 8800 mark for the first time in history. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 ‘착시 빠진 증시… 반도체 빼면 코스피 4100선 불과’하다는 제목의 기사를 공유했다. 이 기사는 삼성전자와 에스케이(SK)하이닉스 등 반도체 업종을 제외한 실질적인 코스피 지수는 4100~4200선에 불과하다는 분석이 제기된다는 내용이었다. 이를 두고 이 대통령은 “‘축구 실력 빼면 손흥민도 보통 사람?’ 이러는 사람 없다”며 “오히려 ‘반도체 빼고도 한국 증시 무려 4100 이래야 하는 거 아니냐”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Mobilize all resources for rescue and response to Hanwha Aerospace accident" (이 대통령 “한화에어로스페이스 사고, 인명 구조에 총동원 대처”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung was briefed on the explosion accident at Hanwha Aerospace's Daejeon plant on the 1st and ordered "the mobilization of all available resources for rescue and accident response." (이재명 대통령이 1일 한화에어로스페이스 대전공장에서 발생한 폭발 사고를 보고 받고 “인명 구조와 사고 수습에 가용한 자원을 총동원해 대처할 것”을 지시했다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung stated that day, "President Lee ordered a thorough investigation into the cause of the accident and the establishment of measures to prevent recurrence." At 10:59 a.m. that day, a 119 report was received regarding an explosion at Hanwha Aerospace's Daejeon plant in Oesam-dong, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, and fire authorities are conducting extinguishing operations. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 “이 대통령이 사고 원인을 철저히 조사하고 추후 재발 방지 대책도 마련할 것을 지시했다”고 밝혔다. 이날 오전 10시59분 대전 유성구 외삼동 한화에어로스페이스 대전공장에서 폭발 사고가 발생했다는 119 신고가 접수됐고, 소방당국이 진화 작업을 벌이고 있다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Foreign Minister Cho Says Korea-Africa Cooperation More Important Amid Middle East Instability (조현 외교장관 “중동 불안정 속 한국-아프리카 협력 더 중요해져”)
item.description:
Foreign Minister Cho emphasized that cooperation between Korea and Africa has become more critical amid global uncertainties in the Middle East and growing instability in supply chains, energy, and food security. (조현 외교부 장관은 중동 정세의 불확실성과 공급망·에너지·식량 안보의 불안이 커진 세계정세에서 한국과 아프리카 간 협력이 더욱 중요해졌다고 강조했다.)

In his opening remarks at the Korea-Africa Foreign Ministers’ Meeting held at the Lotte Hotel in Seoul on the 1st, Minister Cho stated, "With continued instability in the Middle East and ongoing uncertainties surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, African countries are gaining greater geopolitical and economic importance on the international stage," clearly expressing his commitment to expanding cooperation with African nations. Minister Cho also noted that President Lee Jae-myung has demonstrated a willingness to cooperate through meetings with leaders from major African countries such as Egypt, South Africa, and Ghana shortly after taking office last year. ( 조 장관은 1일 서울 롯데호텔에서 열린 한-아프리카 외교장관회의 개회사에서 “중동 지역의 지속적인 불안정과 호르무즈 해협을 둘러싼 불확실성이 계속되는 가운데, 아프리카 국가들은 국제무대에서 지정학적·경제적 중요성이 더욱 커지고 있다”면서 아프리카 국가들과의 협력을 확대하겠다는 의지를 분명히 했다. 조 장관은 이재명 대통령이 지난해 취임 직후부터 이집트·남아프리카공화국·가나 등 아프리카 주요국가 정상들과 회담을 하며 협력 의지를 보였다고도 밝혔다. )

Minister Cho remarked, "Africa is the world’s youngest continent with immense growth potential, widely regarded as the 'continent of the future.' It is located at the crossroads of key maritime routes connecting the Atlantic, Indian Ocean, and Gulf of Aden, and is estimated to hold about 30% of the world’s critical mineral reserves." ( 조 장관은 “아프리카는 막대한 성장 잠재력을 보유한 세계에서 가장 젊은 대륙으로서, 널리 ‘미래의 대륙’으로 평가받고 있다”면서 “아프리카는 대서양, 인도양, 아덴만을 연결하는 주요 해상 교통로의 교차점에 위치해 있으며, 전 세계 핵심 광물 매장량의 약 30%를 보유하고 있는 것으로 추정된다”고 말했다.)

Minister Cho also expressed his intention to share Korea’s experience of developing its economy and democracy in a short period from the devastation of war, when its per capita gross national income (GNI) was only $67. He cited an East African proverb, "When spider webs unite, they can tie up a lion," adding, "The challenges we face today can be addressed more effectively when Korea and Africa combine their respective experiences and strengths." ( 조 장관은 한국이 과거 1인당 국민총소득(GNI)이 67달러에 불과한 전쟁의 폐허 속에서 짧은 기간에 경제·민주주의를 발전시켰던 경험을 아프리카의 파트너들과 공유하겠다는 뜻도 밝혔다. 그는 ‘거미줄도 함께 모이면 사자를 묶을 수 있다’는 동아프리카 속담을 언급하며 “오늘날 우리가 직면한 도전들은 한국과 아프리카가 각자의 경험과 강점을 함께 모을 때 더 효과적으로 대응할 수 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

The Korea-Africa Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, which opened this day, was attended by foreign minister-level officials from 50 African countries and representatives from four regional organizations: the African Union (AU), the African Development Bank (AfDB), the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), and the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). This marks the first time Korea has invited all African countries and regional international organizations as a group to hold a meeting. ( 이날 개막한 한-아프리카 외교장관회의에는 아프리카 대륙의 50개국 외교장관급 인사들과 4개 지역기구인 아프리카연합(AU)·아프리카개발은행(AfDB)·아프리카대륙자유무역지대(AfCFTA)·아프리카 질병통제예방센터(CDC)가 참여했다. 한국이 아프리카 지역 국가 전체와 지역국제기구를 단독으로 초청해 회의를 개최한 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

Africa has recently drawn attention for its strategic value due to oil supply disruptions from the U.S.-Iran conflict, U.S.-China tensions, and the rise of protectionism. The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae announced on the 1st that President Lee Jae-myung would meet with about 20 minister-level officials from African countries who visited Korea for the meeting on the 2nd to discuss ways to enhance Korea-Africa cooperation. ( 아프리카는 최근 미-이란전쟁으로 인한 원유 공급 차질과 미·중 갈등, 보호무역주의 강화 등으로 그 전략적 가치가 주목받고 있다. 이재명 대통령은 2일 이번 회의 참석을 위해 방한한 아프리카 국가들의 장관급 인사 20여명을 접견하고 한국과 아프리카의 협력 증진 방안들을 논의한다고 청와대가 1일 밝혔다.)

The Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, held under the theme "Korea-Africa Partnership for Joint Response in a Global Transition Period," featured its first session on "Strengthening Economic Cooperation" and a second session on "Joint Response to Global Challenges: Korea-Africa Solidarity." The Ministry of Foreign Affairs plans to adopt a outcome document summarizing the discussions. The document is expected to outline the direction of Korea-Africa cooperation based on shared prosperity centered on economic cooperation and future growth engines, as well as joint responses to global challenges. (‘글로벌 전환기 속 공동 대응을 위한 한-아프리카 파트너십’을 주제로 열린 1일 외교장관 회의에서 첫 세션은 ‘경제협력 강화’를 의제로 세션 2는 ‘글로벌 도전에 대한 공동 대응: 한-아프리카 연대’를 의제로 진행됐다. 외교부는 이번 회의에서 논의된 내용을 담은 결과 문서도 채택할 계획이다. 이 문서에는 경제협력과 미래 성장동력을 주제로 한 공동 번영, 글로벌 도전 과제에 대한 공동 대응을 토대로 하는 한-아프리카 협력 방향 등의 내용이 담길 것으로 보인다.)

On the 2nd, a Korea-Africa Business Forum will be held as a side event to the Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, with around 300 participants including business leaders, government officials, and diplomats from Korea and Africa. After Minister Cho’s opening remarks, keynote speeches will be delivered by Sung Kim, President of Hyundai Motor’s Strategic Planning Division, and Wamkele Mene, Secretary-General of the AfCFTA. ( 2일에는 외교장관회의 부대 행사로 한국과 아프리카의 기업인, 정부 인사, 외교 인사 등 300여 명이 참석하는 한-아프리카 비즈니스 포럼이 개최된다. 조 장관의 개회사에 이어 성 김 현대차 전략기획담당사장, 웸켈레 메네 AfCFTA 사무총장이 각각 기조연설을 한다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr ( 박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Hanwha Aerospace Explosion Accident…Rival Parties Ban Campaign Slogan Songs and Dance Moves (한화에어로 폭발 사고에…여야, 선거 로고송·율동 금지)
item.description:
In connection with the fatal explosion accident that occurred on the 1st at the Hanwha Aerospace plant in Daejeon, political parties, with just two days left until the June 3 local elections, have decided to ban the use of campaign slogan songs and dance moves during electioneering, and to suspend or scale back their campaign rallies. (1일 대전 한화에어로스페이스 공장에서 발생한 폭발 사망 사고와 관련해, 6·3 지방선거를 이틀 앞둔 정당들은 선거운동 과정에서 로고송 사용과 율동을 금지하고, 유세를 중단 또는 축소하기로 했다.)

Jung Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, issued an urgent directive, stating, “All Democratic Party candidates and campaign teams nationwide are to ban the use of slogan songs and dance moves, as well as suspend campaign rallies.” Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, issued an urgent directive stating, “All People Power Party candidates and campaign teams nationwide are to refrain from using slogan songs and dance moves, and proceed with a subdued election campaign.” Cho Kuk, the leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, also issued an urgent directive to all candidates and campaign teams nationwide to prohibit the use of slogan songs and dance moves, urging them to “conduct calm campaign rallies and, if possible, phone-based electioneering.” The New Reform Party requested “to proceed with election campaigning in a calm manner,” and the Justice Party also set a policy of refraining from using slogan songs and dance moves. <<> Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate running for Seoul mayor, temporarily suspended his campaign rallies, and Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, also stated, “Today’s campaign rallies will proceed on a calm and quiet schedule.” <<> At 10:59 a.m. on this day, an explosion accident occurred at the Hanwha Aerospace Daejeon plant in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, resulting in five people injured and two fatalities. <<> Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 “전국의 민주당 후보와 캠프는 로고송 사용과 율동 금지는 물론, 유세를 중단하라”고 긴급 지시했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 “전국 국민의힘 후보와 선거 캠프는 로고송 사용과 율동을 자제하고, 차분한 선거 운동을 진행할 것”을 긴급 지시했다. 조국 조국혁신당 대표도 전국 후보와 선거 캠프에 로고송 사용과 율동 등을 금지할 것을 긴급 지시하고, “차분한 유세, 가능한 전화 선거운동을 하라”고 당부했다. 개혁신당은 “차분한 기조 속에 선거운동을 진행해 달라”고 당부했고, 정의당도 로고송과 율동 자제 방침을 내렸다.)

item.title: “We’re All in This Together, Time to Stop”… Democratic Party Lawmakers from TK Region Appeal for Support for Kim Boo-kyum (“우리가 남이가, 이제 그만”…TK 출신 민주당 의원들, 김부겸 지지 호소)
item.description:
Lawmakers from the Democratic Party who are either from the Daegu region or have connections with Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party’s candidate for Daegu mayor, appealed to voters in Daegu, saying, “For this election, please look at the person, not the party,” urging support for Kim. (대구 지역 출신이거나 김부겸 더불어민주당 대구시장 후보와 인연이 있는 민주당 의원들이 대구지역 유권자들을 향해 “이번만큼은 정당이 아닌 인물을 봐달라”며 김 후보에 대한 지지를 호소했다.)

On the 1st, Han Jeong-ae, chair of the Democratic Party’s Policy Committee; Kwon Chil-seung, co-chair of Kim’s campaign committee; along with lawmakers Lee Jae-jeong, Park Hae-cheol, and Im Mi-ae, and spokesperson Jang Yoon-mi held a press conference at the National Assembly Communication Hall, stating, “We earnestly ask you to give one last chance to Candidate Kim, who is ready to dedicate himself solely to Daegu’s development, to work for Daegu.” (민주당 한정애 정책위의장과 김 후보 캠프 공동선대위원장인 권칠승 의원, 이재정·박해철·임미애 의원, 장윤미 대변인은 1일 국회 소통관에서 기자회견을 열어 “오직 대구 발전을 위해 헌신할 준비가 돼 있는 김 후보에게 대구를 위해 일할 마지막 기회를 주시기를 간절하게 청한다”고 밝혔다.)

In the press statement, they said, “The essence of this election is very clear,” adding, “It is not about outdated factional logic or blind party-line voting. It is an election to choose whether to revive Daegu’s economy, which has collapsed beyond repair, or to sink deeper into a quagmire of stagnation.” (이들은 기자회견문에서 “이번 선거의 본질은 너무나 명확하다”며 “낡은 진영 논리나 맹목적인 정당 투표가 아니다. 무너질 대로 무너진 대구 경제를 회복시킬 것인가, 아니면 더 깊은 침체의 수렁 속으로 빠져들 것인가를 선택하는 선거”라고 했다.)

They noted, “For the long period of the past 30 years, the People Power Party and its predecessor parties have enjoyed a political monopoly in Daegu with virtually no checks or competition,” and added, “The report card of this one-party monopoly is truly devastating. For 30 years, the shameful label of ranking last in the nation in per capita GRDP (Gross Regional Domestic Product) has been attached to Daegu’s name.” (이들은 “지난 30년이라는 긴 시간 동안, 국민의힘과 그 전신 정당들은 대구에서 사실상 아무런 견제와 경쟁없이 정치적 독점을 누려왔다”며 “일당 독점의 성적표는 너무나도 참혹하다. 30년째 1인당 지알디피(GRDP·지역내총생산) 전국 최하위라는 불명예스러운 꼬리표가 대구 이름 뒤에 붙어 다닌다”고 했다.)

They continued, “How much longer must we cover up this dire reality with the phrase ‘We’re all in this together’? Daegu should no longer be confined to the distorted, narrow framework of being a specific party’s ‘home turf’ or the ‘heart of conservatism.’” (그러면서 “언제까지 이 참담한 현실을 ‘우리가 남이가’라는 말 한마디로 덮고 가야 하나. 대구는 더 이상 특정 정당의 ‘안방’이나 ‘보수의 심장’이라는 왜곡된 좁은 틀에 갇혀 있어서는 안 된다”고 했다.)

Regarding the opposing candidate, Choo Kyung-ho of the People Power Party running for Daegu mayor, they stated, “He is not only a figure representing the monopolistic party that has ruined Daegu’s economy over the past 30 years, but he is also indicted on the serious charge of ‘engaging in important duties related to insurrection’ and is standing before the court. He may even have to travel to the criminal courtroom of the Seoul Central District Court almost every week to attend his trial.” (상대 후보인 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보에 대해선 “지난 30년간 대구 경제를 망쳐온 독점 정당을 대변하는 인물일 뿐만 아니라, ‘내란중요임무종사’라는 무거운 혐의로 기소되어 법정 심판대에 올라 있는 상태다. 일주일이 멀다 하고 서울중앙지법 형사법정 피고인석에 앉아 재판을 받으러 다녀야 할지도 모른다”고 했다.)

They appealed, “Instead of a candidate who is a criminal defendant soon to face trial, please choose Kim Boo-kyum—a truly capable worker who is ready to work day and night, focusing only on Daegu’s citizens.” (이들은 “조만간 재판 받아야 하는 형사 피고인 후보 대신, 오직 대구 시민만을 바라보고 밤낮으로 일 할 준비가 된 능력있는 진짜 일꾼, 김부겸을 선택해달라”고 호소했다.)

After the press conference, lawmaker Kwon Chil-seung told reporters, “The on-the-ground atmosphere is even better than in the most Democratic-leaning areas of the metropolitan region,” and added, “There are both ‘shy conservatives’ and ‘shy Kim Boo-kyum supporters,’ but it seems there are slightly more ‘shy Kim supporters.’” Regarding the impact of former President Park Geun-hye’s campaign rally in Daegu, he said, “We don’t see it as affecting the election dynamics, but we view it as a regrettable, regressive act that sets politics back in Daegu,” and added, “I believe Daegu’s citizens will make a wise judgment.” (권칠승 의원은 기자회견을 마친 뒤 취재진에 “현장 분위기는 수도권에 민주당이 가장 우세한 지역보다도 더 좋은 분위기”라며 “‘샤이 보수’도 있고 ‘샤이 부겸’도 있다는데 ‘샤이 부겸’이 조금 더 많은 것 같다”고 했다. 박근혜 전 대통령의 대구 지원 유세 영향에 대해서는 “선거 판세에 영향 준다고 보고 있지 않지만 대구에 정치를 후퇴시키는 퇴행적 행태라는 안타까움을 가지고 있다”며 “대구시민들께서 현명한 판단해주실 거라 믿는다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, on the 1st, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae ordered all party candidates to suspend their campaign activities in connection with an explosion that occurred at around 10:59 a.m. at Hanwha Aerospace’s Daejeon plant in Oesam-dong, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. (한편 정청래 민주당 대표는 1일 오전 10시59분께 대전 유성구 외삼동 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장에서 발생한 폭발 사고와 관련해 전국의 모든 후보에게 유세를 중단하도록 했다.)

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kwanhun Club Presents Plaque of Appreciation to U.S. Embassy in Seoul (관훈클럽, 주한미국대사관에 감사패 수여)
item.description:
The Kwanhun Club held an event on March 1 at the Korea Press Center in Seoul to present a plaque of appreciation to the U.S. Embassy in Seoul, marking the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States. The Kwanhun Club was established in 1957, centered on journalists who had received training in the United States with the support of the U.S. Embassy in Seoul and related U.S. government agencies after the Korean War. (관훈클럽은 1일 서울 한국프레스센터에서 미국 건국 250주년을 맞아 주한 미국대사관에 감사패를 주는 행사를 열었다. 관훈클럽은 6·25전쟁 이후 주한미국대사관과 미국 정부 관련 기관의 지원을 받아 미국 연수를 다녀온 언론인을 중심으로 1957년 창립됐다.)

Lee Ha-won, secretary general of the Kwanhun Club, said at the event, "We organized this event to express our gratitude for the friendship and support that the U.S. Embassy in Seoul has shown over a long period," adding, "Going forward, the Kwanhun Club will continue to serve as a bridge of friendship and cooperation between South Korea and the United States." James Heller, Deputy Chief of Mission at the U.S. Embassy, stated, "As the United States marks its 250th anniversary this year, celebrating this occasion with the Kwanhun Club makes it all the more meaningful." <<> Approximately 30 people attended the event, including Heller and other officials from the U.S. Embassy, Rep. Kim Kun of the People Power Party, and Jeong Yeon-doo, head of the Foreign Ministry's Office of Diplomatic Strategy and Information. <<> Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (이하원 관훈클럽 총무는 이날 행사에서 “주한 미국대사관이 오랜 기간 보여준 우정과 성원에 감사의 뜻을 전하고자 이번 행사를 마련했다”라며 “앞으로도 관훈클럽은 한미 양국 간 우호와 협력의 가교 역할을 이어가겠다”고 밝혔다. 제임스 헬러 미국 대사대리는 “미국이 올해 건국 250주년을 맞이한 시점에서 관훈클럽과 이를 기념하게 돼 더욱 뜻깊게 생각한다”라고 말했다.)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok on "Vote-Cutting" Controversy: "More Absurd than Jo Se-ho's 'No-Show' at Wedding" (‘투표 새치기 논란’ 이준석 “조세호 ‘결혼식 불참’보다 더 황당”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, has repeatedly expressed his frustration over the "advance voting queue-jumping" controversy, stating, "It's more absurd than when Jo Se-ho was criticized for not attending a wedding and said, 'How could I go if I don't know the person?'" (이준석 개혁신당 대표가 ‘사전투표 새치기’ 논란에 거듭 억울해하며 “조세호씨가 결혼식 불참 지적을 받았을 때 ‘모르는 사람인데 어떻게 가냐’고 했던 것보다 더 황당하다”고 말했다.)

At the Reform Party's on-site central election campaign committee held in Incheon on the 1st, Lee said, "All I can say is, 'How can you line up when there is no line?'" (이 대표는 1일 인천에서 진행한 개혁신당 현장 중앙선거대책위원회에서 “‘줄이 없는데 어떻게 줄을 서냐’라고 밖에 말할 수 없는 상황”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

Earlier, on May 29, the first day of advance voting for the June 3 local elections, Lee visited an early voting station at the Dongtan 9-dong Administrative Welfare Center in Hwaseong, Gyeonggi Province, where a citizen confronted him, asking why he wasn't joining the queue. (앞서 이 대표는 6·3 지방선거 사전투표 첫날인 지난달 29일 경기 화성시 동탄9동 행정복지센터 사전투표소를 찾았다가 한 시민으로부터 ‘왜 줄을 서지 않느냐’는 취지의 항의를 받았다.)

In response, Lee insisted there was no waiting line at the time and announced legal action against accounts spreading claims that he had cut in line. (이에 이 대표는 당시 투표 대기 줄이 없었다면서, 자신이 새치기했다고 유포하는 계정들에 대해 법적 대응 방침을 밝힌 바 있다.)

On the same day, Lee pushed back again. "The facts are simple," he said. "A voter mistakenly thought from the wrong spot and asked, 'Why aren't you standing in line?' That's all there is to it." He added, "Spreading falsehoods takes just one click. But correcting them is impossible even with thousands of times the effort." (이 대표는 이날 또다시 반발했다. 이 대표는 “사실 관계는 단순하다”며 “한 유권자가 엉뚱한 위치에서 착각하시고 ‘왜 줄을 안 서느냐’고 하셨다. 그것이 전부다”라고 했다. 이어 “거짓을 퍼뜨리는 데에는 클릭 한 번이면 된다. (그러나) 그것을 바로잡는 것은 수천 배의 노력으로도 불가능하다”고 말했다.)

Lee noted, "The reason 'smear campaigns' haven't disappeared in the SNS era is precisely because of this tilted unfairness. Smaller parties are especially vulnerable to such tactics." (이 대표는 “에스엔에스(SNS) 시대에 마타도어가 사라지지 않는 이유가 바로 이 기울어진 불공평함에 있다”며 “특히 덩치가 작은 정당일수록 이런 공작에 내성이 약하다”고도 했다.)

"The broadcaster that first posted the video even removed it after checking the context. But netizens added strange subtitles, created an absurd 'queue-jumping' frame, and spread it," Lee said. "Correcting a single line of lies takes hundreds of times the effort. Even then, some wounds never heal." He added, "What can eliminate the place for smear campaigns? Wise citizens who seek out the exact truth, casting their votes with public sentiment that outweighs and extinguishes that malice—that's correcting the scars left by lies with ballots." (이 대표는 “영상을 처음 올린 방송사조차 전후 상황을 확인하고 곧바로 내렸다. 그런데 (누리꾼들이) 희한한 자막을 입혀 ‘새치기’라는 어이없는 프레임을 만들어 퍼뜨렸다”며 “한 줄로 지어진 거짓을 바로잡는 데에는 그 수백 배의 노력이 든다. 그러고도 어떤 상처는 끝내 회복되지 않는다”고 말했다. 이 대표는 “마타도어가 설 자리를 없애는 길은 무엇이겠냐. 정확히 사실을 알아보신 현명한 시민들께서 그 악의를 덮고도 남을 민의로 투표장에 나오시는 것”이라며 “거짓이 남긴 흠집을 표로 교정해 주시는 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: "It Wasn't President MB Calling Someone a 'Bad Person'" – Park Min-shik: "There Were Even More Specific Remarks" (한동훈 “‘나쁜 사람’ MB 말 아냐” 박민식 “더 구체적인 말도 있어”)
item.description:
On the 1st, Park Min-shik, the People Power Party candidate for the June 3rd by-election in Busan's Buk-gu district, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon engaged in a war of words over who former President Lee Myung-bak's recent "bad person" comment referred to during his visit to Busan. Meanwhile, Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party candidate, kept his distance from the two candidates' power struggle to capture conservative voters in the final stretch, continuing a "stealth" campaign. <<> Candidate Han held a press conference at his Busan Buk-gu election office that day, stating that former President Lee's "bad person" comment "was not something former President Lee said." This was a rebuttal to Park, who after meeting former President Lee during his Busan visit on May 31st, posted on Facebook: "'Fight to the end. If a good person fights a bad person, you must win. You will definitely win.' Today, former President Lee Myung-bak firmly grasped my hand and stressed this two or three times," effectively implying that the "bad person" was Han. Han further said to Park, "I don't understand why you keep going elsewhere when this is an election for Buk-gu." Former President Lee had visited Busan to campaign for People Power Party Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon in the June 3rd local elections, and Han's remark appeared to criticize Park for meeting former President Lee in Haeundae-gu rather than Buk-gu. <<> In response, Park countered at a press conference at his Buk-gu election office: "(Former President Lee) is the greatest elder in our conservative camp. If I carelessly distorted the words of such a person, that would be political impropriety. I wrote down former President Lee's words verbatim," and added, "In fact, there were even more specific remarks, but I'll hold back." <<> Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party candidate, maintained his distance from the fierce verbal clash between the conservative candidates, continuing a "stealth" campaign that emphasized his own suitability, as the ruling party's candidate, for developing Buk-gu. At a press conference in the Busan City Council briefing room that day, when asked by reporters about former President Lee's Busan visit and the "conservative rebuilding" dispute between Park and Han, Ha said, "We need to re-examine how agendas like conservative unity or conservative rebuilding can contribute to solving Buk-gu's pressing issues," and added, "What Buk-gu needs right now is not ideological debate." <<> Reported by Jo Hee-yeon and Ko Han-sol, choh@hani.co.kr (6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 박민식 국민의힘 후보와 한동훈 무소속 후보가 최근 부산을 방문한 이명박 전 대통령의 ‘나쁜 사람’ 발언이 누구를 지칭한 것인지를 두고 1일 신경전을 벌였다. 하정우 더불어민주당 후보는 막판 보수층 표심을 잡기 위한 두 후보의 기싸움에 거리를 두고 ‘스텔스’ 선거 운동을 이어갔다.)

item.title: Democratic Party says “humbly,” People Power Party says “we reflect” — lowering their stance while continuing attacks on “corrupt practices” and “arrogance” (민주 “겸손하게” 국힘 “반성한다” 몸 낮추며 “적폐” “오만” 공세 계속)
item.description:
On June 1st, two days before the June 3rd local elections and by-elections for National Assembly seats, the Democratic Party and the People Power Party both lowered their stance to appeal to voters. (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재보궐선거를 이틀 앞둔 1일, 더불어민주당과 국민의힘이 서로 몸을 낮추며 표심에 호소했다.)

The Democratic Party’s Central Election Committee’s General Election Strategy Headquarters (led by Headquarters Chief Cho Seung-rae) announced that from 6 a.m., they would switch to a “60-hour emergency operations room system.” During this period, the Headquarters notified all party members of codes of conduct, stating, “Thoroughly guard against inappropriate words and actions that may appear complacent or arrogant, and convey urgency to voters with a low and humble attitude.” This was aimed at preventing decisive mistakes, such as slip-ups, in the final stretch of the campaign. (민주당 중앙당 선거대책위원회 총괄선거대책본부장실(본부장 조승래)은 이날 아침 6시부터 ‘60시간 상황실 비상가동체제’로 전환한다고 밝혔다. 선대본부장실은 이 기간 전 당원들에게 “자만하거나 오만하게 비칠 수 있는 부적절한 언행을 철저히 경계하고, 낮고 겸손한 자세로 유권자들에게 절실함을 전달한다”는 행동 수칙을 공지했다. 선거 막바지 설화 등 결정적인 실수를 할 가능성을 단속한 것이다.)

The People Power Party lowered their stance in a “reflection” mode. (국민의힘은 ‘반성’ 모드로 몸을 낮췄다.)

Floor Leader Song Eon-seok held a press briefing at the National Assembly to appeal to the public, saying, “We are well aware that the public views the People Power Party as being very lacking, and we feel sorry and reflect on that.” He added, “Shouldn’t we press the control button once for the ruling forces intoxicated by the taste of power?” Policy Committee Chairman Jeong Jeom-sik also said, “We reflect profoundly on the People Power Party’s shortcomings. We will reform and change with a lower stance and more desperately. Please, be sure to come out to the main polling station.” (송언석 원내대표는 국회에서 대국민 호소 기자간담회를 열어 “국민의힘이 많이 부족하다고 보시는 것을 잘 알고 있고, 송구하게 생각하고 반성한다”며 “권력의 맛에 도취한 집권 세력에게 제어 버튼 한번 눌러줘야 하지 않느냐”라고 말했다. 정점식 정책위의장도 “국민의힘이 부족했던 점을 뼈저리게 반성한다. 더 낮은 자세로 더 처절하게 쇄신하고 변화하겠다”며 “반드시 본투표장에 나와달라”고 했다.)

Amid this, the leaders of both parties continued their harsh attacks on each other. (이런 가운데서도 양당 대표는 상대를 향해 거친 공세를 이어갔다.)

Democratic Party Leader Jeong Cheong-rae said during a Central Election Committee meeting in Cheonan, South Chungcheong Province, “This election will be a grand prelude to breaking away from the old ways, corrupt practices, and insurgent forces that are eating away at South Korea, and moving toward a great leap forward.” Referring to former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye, who have supported People Power Party candidates, and the imprisoned former President Yoon Seok-youl, he called them the “prison trio” and said, “We must extinguish the embers of the insurgency that is stirring.” (정청래 민주당 대표는 충남 천안에서 열린 중앙선대위 회의에서 “이번 선거는 대한민국을 좀먹는 구태·적폐·내란 세력과 단절하고 대도약으로 나아가는 장대한 서막이 될 것”이라고 했다. 그는 국민의힘 후보 지원에 나선 이명박·박근혜 전 대통령과 수감 중인 윤석열 전 대통령을 묶어 “감옥 3인방”이라며 “준동하는 내란의 잔불을 제거해야 한다”고 말했다.)

People Power Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk also wrote on Facebook, “Democratic Party’s Jeong Cheong-rae said, ‘If you made money from stocks, vote for the Democratic Party,’ which is a truly arrogant remark that ignores the people.” He added, “We must judge Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party for destroying livelihoods. If you give up voting, an even harsher hell will begin.” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표도 페이스북에 올린 글에 “민주당 정청래는 ‘주식 해서 돈 벌었으면 민주당에 투표하라’고 하는데, 국민을 무시하는 참으로 오만한 발언”이라며 “이재명과 민주당의 민생 파탄을 심판해야 한다. 투표를 포기하면 더 혹독한 지옥이 시작될 것”이라고 썼다.)

Reporter Choi Ha-yan: chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Jang Na-rae: wing@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Election D-2, President Lee Emphasizes 'Real Estate Normalization'… "No Illegal Speculation" (선거 D-2, 이 대통령 ‘부동산 정상화’ 강조…“불법투기 안 돼”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 1st, "We must definitely escape the ruinous republic of unearned real estate income." It has been 11 days since President Lee last posted a message related to real estate. With real estate emerging as a major issue in the June 3 local elections, this appears to be a renewed emphasis on his commitment to normalizing the real estate market. (이재명 대통령이 1일 “망국적인 부동산 불로소득 공화국은 반드시 탈출할 것”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령이 부동산 관련 메시지를 직접 올린 것은 11일 만이다. 부동산이 6·3 지방선거 주요 쟁점이 된 가운데 부동산 정상화 의지를 다시 한번 강조한 것으로 보인다.)

On this day, President Lee shared an article titled "Up to 4 billion won in rewards, reports surge… 8 out of 10 real estate tax evasion reports from the Seoul metropolitan area" on X (formerly Twitter), stating, "Tax evasion through illegal real estate speculation is no longer acceptable." The article noted that 8 out of 10 reports received by the National Tax Service's 'Real Estate Tax Evasion Reporting Center' were concentrated in Seoul, Gyeonggi, and Incheon. The National Tax Service pays informants who provide crucial data leading to tax collections of 50 million won or more up to 4 billion won in rewards, depending on the amount of tax evaded. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “부동산 불법투기 탈세, 이제는 안 된다”며 ‘최대 40억 포상금에 신고 폭주…부동산 탈세 제보 10건 중 8건 수도권’이라는 제목의 기사를 공유했다. 이 기사는 국세청이 운영 중인 ‘부동산 탈세 신고 센터’에 접수된 제보 10건 중 8건이 서울·경기·인천 등에 집중됐다는 내용이었다. 국세청은 제보자가 중요 자료를 제공해 5천만원 이상 세금이 추징되면 탈루 세액에 따라 최대 40억원의 포상금을 지급한다.)

President Lee had previously refrained from commenting on the most sensitive issue of real estate ahead of the local elections. His last message related to real estate was on the 21st, when he refuted an article claiming that 'a Chinese national bought 944 apartments in Seoul's Gangnam,' writing, "Between January and April, only 5 Chinese nationals purchased collective buildings in Gangnam-gu." President Lee's renewed real estate message after 11 days is interpreted as an attempt to emphasize the government's commitment to normalizing the real estate market, amid the opposition party highlighting real estate issues as an election talking point. A Blue House official stated, "This reiterates the strong will to normalize illegal activities in real estate." (이 대통령은 그동안 지방선거를 앞두고 가장 예민한 부동산 문제에 대해선 언급을 자제해왔다. 지난 21일 ‘중국인이 서울 강남 아파트 944채를 매수했다’는 기사를 반박하며 “1~4월간 강남구 집합건물 중국인 매수는 5명에 불과하다”고 쓴 게 마지막 부동산 관련 메시지였다. 이 대통령이 11일 만에 부동산 관련 메시지를 다시 낸 것은 야당이 부동산 문제를 선거 쟁점으로 부각하는 상황에서 정부의 부동산 시장 정상화 의지를 강조하려는 의도로 풀이된다. 청와대 관계자는 “부동산 불법행위에 대한 정상화 의지가 강하다는 것을 재차 강조한 것”이라고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee also voiced his opinions on the stock market on this day. Sharing an article stating that the KOSPI index would be 4100 excluding semiconductors, he said, "Semiconductors are one of the core industries of our country, so I find it hard to understand why we need to calculate the composite stock index excluding them." He added, "People don't say, 'Excluding his soccer skills, Son Heung-min is just an ordinary person?' Rather, shouldn't it be, 'Even excluding semiconductors, the Korean stock market is a whopping 4100'?" On that day, the KOSPI closed at 8788.38, reaching an all-time high. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (한편, 이 대통령은 이날 증시와 관련해서도 목소리를 냈다. 반도체를 빼면 코스피 지수가 4100이라는 기사를 공유하며 “반도체가 우리 산업의 핵심 중 하나인데, 왜 반도체를 빼고 종합주가지수를 계산해야 하는지 이해가 잘 안된다”고 말했다. 그러면서 이 대통령은 “‘축구 실력 빼면 손흥민도 보통 사람?’ 이러는 사람 없다”며 “오히려 ‘반도체 빼고도 한국 증시 무려 4100’ 이래야 하는 거 아니냐”고 말했다. 이날 코스피는 8788.38로 거래를 마치며 사상 최고치를 경신했다.)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Parties Keep Campaigns 'As Quiet as Possible' After Hanwha Aerospace Accident in Daejeon (대전 한화 에어로 사고에 여야 선거운동 ‘최대한 조용히’)
item.description:
On June 1, two days before the June 3 local elections, the ruling and opposition parties either completely halted or ordered a restraint on noisy campaigning nationwide after the explosion and fatal accident at Hanwha Aerospace in Daejeon. (6·3 지방선거를 이틀 앞둔 1일, 여야는 대전 한화에어로스페이스 폭발 사망 사고가 발생하자 전국 선거운동을 전면 중단하거나 요란한 선거운동을 자제하도록 했다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea announced through a media notice on the same day that "Party leader Chung Cheong-rae has urgently instructed all candidates' camps nationwide to stop using campaign songs and choreography, as well as to suspend all campaign rallies." In response, campaign camps including that of Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh immediately temporarily suspended electioneering. Party leader Chung halted his own campaign schedule and visited the accident site in Daejeon around 5 p.m. that day. Cho Kuk, candidate for the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, also stated via a media notice, "Instead of standing on campaign vehicles and grabbing the microphone, we will quietly and calmly meet voters directly." (더불어민주당은 이날 낮 언론 공지를 통해 “정청래 당대표는 사고와 관련해서 전국의 민주당 후보 캠프에 로고송 사용과 율동 금지는 물론, 전국 모든 후보들에게 유세 중단을 긴급 지시했다”고 밝혔다. 이에 따라 정원오 서울시장 후보 캠프 등 각 캠프는 곧장 선거 유세를 잠정 중단했다. 정 대표는 유세 일정을 중단하고 이날 오후 5시께 대전 사고 현장을 찾았다. 조국 조국혁신당 후보도 언론 공지를 통해 “유세차에 올라 마이크를 잡는 대신, 조용하게 차분하게 유권자들을 직접 찾아 뵙겠다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party's central election committee announced that party leader Jang Dong-hyuk also "urgently instructed all candidates and campaign camps nationwide to refrain from using campaign songs and choreography and to conduct restrained campaigning." Party leader Jang visited the Daejeon accident site around 7 p.m. that evening. The campaign of Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon canceled a scheduled press conference in the afternoon, stating that "the campaign will proceed with a calm and quiet schedule." The Reform Party and the Justice Party also urged their candidates nationwide to refrain from using campaign songs and choreography. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표도 “전국 국민의힘 후보와 선거 캠프에 로고송 사용과 율동을 자제하고 차분한 선거운동을 진행할 것”을 긴급 지시했다고 당 중앙선거대책위원회가 밝혔다. 장 대표도 이날 저녁 7시께 대전 사고 현장을 찾았다. 오세훈 서울시장 후보 캠프는 오후 예정된 기자회견을 취소하면서 “유세는 차분하고 조용한 일정으로 진행한다는 방침”이라고 밝혔다. 개혁신당과 정의당 등도 전국 후보들에게 로고송 사용과 율동을 자제할 것을 주문했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr 최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Unification attempt collapses amid 'Fake Democratic Party' emotional clash… extreme conflict between Cho Kuk and Kim Yong-nam (‘가짜 민주당’ 감정싸움 끝에 단일화 무산…조국-김용남 ‘극한 갈등’)
item.description:
The verbal sparring between Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, and Cho Kuk, the candidate for the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, has escalated into a near-mutual slander brawl, deepening the rift between the two parties. <<> Lee Hae-min, the general head of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party's election campaign committee, held a press briefing at the National Assembly on the 1st, saying, "In Pyeongtaek, a year ago, someone who wore red clothes for a long time, then briefly put on orange clothes, and when he wasn't nominated (there), changed into blue clothes is acting as a fake Democratic Party candidate. His value is not Lee Jae-myung's value, but power and money," adding, "This perfectly suits a chameleon-like former prosecutor candidate who changed party affiliations chasing power and nominations here and there." This was a direct strike at Kim Yong-nam, a former prosecutor who moved his party affiliation from the People Power Party to the Reform Party and then to the Democratic Party. <<> Kim Yong-nam's campaign also issued a commentary, strongly criticizing Cho Kuk for acting as a 'fake Democratic Party' candidate. <<> In the commentary, Kim's campaign said, "If Cho Kuk can just hang a party badge, it's not surprising that he would sacrifice his pride and act like a pseudo-candidate of another party," and "As for the so-called 'self-reliant first place' strategy that Cho mentioned, no matter how you look at it—like 'acting like a fake Democrat,' 'impersonating a democracy camp candidate,' 'merging with the Democratic Party,' or 'negative campaigning against the Democratic Party candidate'—it's natural that there's nothing of their own, which is almost pitiful." The campaign also brought up past sexual assault cases within the Innovation Party regarding the merger with the Democratic Party that Cho's side had left open, criticizing, "Unless he's a psychopath, I don't know why he keeps pushing. Even though we clearly expressed our refusal, persistently courting is also sexual violence. It seems they don't realize this, perhaps because they are the 'Sexual Assault Party.'" <<> The two parties also engaged in a war of nerves over the 'merger' issue. <<> Cho Kuk has consistently expressed the stance that if elected, he will lead a merger with the Democratic Party. However, the Democratic Party has drawn a line, stating that Cho's election outcome is irrelevant to the merger. Cho Seung-rae, the general election campaign chief, said, "There was a debate within the party about the merger with the Innovation Party last time, and we agreed to postpone discussions until after the local elections," adding, "Cho's election outcome has nothing to do with the merger discussions. (Cho's claim that no merger is possible if he loses is a forced argument.)" item.title: Chungcheong ‘Central Plains Blitz’ Takes Center Stage… Jeong Cheong-rae and Jang Dong-hyuk Skip Busan (‘중원 바람몰이’ 충청 총력전…정청래·장동혁, 부산엔 안갔다)
item.description:
During the official campaign period for the June 3 local elections, it was revealed that Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, and Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, allocated the most time to the Chungcheong region, focusing on winning over voters in this battleground. The Chungcheong region, where fixed partisan loyalties are relatively weak, is considered a ‘political central plains’ that gauges the direction of public sentiment in every election. <<> ■ Jeong Cheong-rae Courts Chungcheong, Avoids Daegu, Busan, and Jeonbuk From May 21, when the official campaign began, to June 1, Jeong visited the Chungnam, Chungbuk, and Daejeon areas a total of 13 times over 12 days. On June 1 alone, he held an on-site central election strategy committee meeting in Cheonan, where the election office of Chungnam Governor candidate Park Su-hyun is located, and then moved to Goesan, Chungbuk, for a street rally. Jeong did not visit Daegu, Busan, or Ulsan, other key battlegrounds, even once, and only visited Gyeongnam once, showing relatively scant attention. This aligns with a strategy to promote the ‘candidate’s personal appeal’ in the conservative-leaning Yeongnam region’s competitive districts. A key official from the Democratic Party leadership told The Hankyoreh, “Under the principle of ‘going if the candidate requests it,’ we visited Chungcheong because candidates in competitive regional and local government races there asked for support. We didn’t visit Yeongnam because we judged that the candidates there have sufficient capabilities.” In Busan’s case, it appears that controversy also played a role, stemming from an incident on May 3, before the official campaign, when Jeong visited the Gupo Market with Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party candidate for the Busan Buk-gu by-election, and told a first-grade elementary school girl, “Say ‘Go for it, brother Jung-woo.’” <<> Jeong also visited Jeonbuk only once, where Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek and independent candidate Kim Kwan-young are competing. A Democratic Party lawmaker from the Jeonbuk region said, “Locally, there’s a sense that it’s actually better (for the Democratic Party’s election) if leader Jeong doesn’t come,” adding that following the ‘envelope money scandal’ that led to Kim’s exclusion from the nomination, “the wounds within the party should be left to heal, and constant meddling won’t help.” Jeong will conclude his campaign on June 2, the final day, starting in Jeongseon and Yeongwol in Gangwon Province, then moving through Gyeonggi Province and Seoul for rallies. <<> <<> ■ Jang Dong-hyuk, Shunned in Seoul, Also Focuses on Chungcheong As of today, Jang has visited the Chungcheong region eight times—four times in Chungnam, three in Daejeon, and once in Sejong—accounting for about a third of his official campaign schedule. Analysts suggest that Jang’s emphasis on campaigning in Chungnam is not unrelated to recent opinion polls showing the gap between the ruling and opposition candidates for Chungnam governor narrowing to single digits, signaling a tight race. <<> A party leadership official said, “The aim is to spark a wave in the Chungcheong central plains that will influence elections in the Seoul metropolitan area and Yeongnam regions.” Regarding Jang not visiting Busan, another battleground, even once, the official noted, “With conservatives rallying around former Presidents Park Geun-hye and Lee Myung-bak’s visits to Busan, there’s no need for Chairman Jang to go there and highlight potential conflict with candidate Han Dong-hoon.” <<> Chungcheong is also home to Jang’s own constituency (Boryeong-Seocheon, Chungnam). This has led to interpretations that his movements reflect a situation where he is unwelcome in other battlegrounds, due to his staunch conservative stance, including refusing to break ties with former President Yoon Seok-yeol. In fact, Jang planned a campaign support rally in Gangseo-gu, Seoul on May 26, but it was cancelled due to internal opposition. Seoul Mayor candidate Oh Se-hoon also did not request Jang’s election support during this campaign period and did not accompany him on his Seoul campaign trail. After starting his official campaign on the first day with a morning greeting rally in Daejeon, Jang plans to continue intensive campaigning in the Chungcheong region on the final day, June 2. <<> By Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr and Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동 기간 정청래 더불어민주당 대표와 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 충청권에 가장 많은 일정을 할애하며 접전지 표심 잡기에 집중한 것으로 나타났다. 충청권은 특정 정당에 대한 고정 지지 성향이 상대적으로 약해 선거 때마다 민심의 향배를 가늠하는 ‘정치적 중원’으로 꼽힌다.)

item.title: President Lee says of government's ‘dollar forced sale’ rumor: "Must be strictly punished" (이 대통령, 정부 ‘달러 강제 매각설’ 거짓 유포에 “반드시 엄단”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 2nd, "Acts that cause social unrest and economic damage by deliberately spreading false information must be tracked down and strictly punished." (이재명 대통령이 2일 “고의적 허위사실 유포로 사회혼란, 경제피해를 야기하는 행위는 반드시 찾아내 엄단해야 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee shared a media report in a post on X (formerly Twitter) that day about the police booking two additional individuals for spreading the ‘dollar forced sale’ rumor, and made this remark. Earlier, following the outbreak of the US-Israel/Iran war, false posts alleging that the government would forcibly sell dollars to respond to the Middle East-triggered economic crisis had spread online. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 올린 글에서 경찰이 ‘달러 강제 매각설’ 유포자 2명을 추가로 입건했다는 내용의 언론 보도를 공유하며 이렇게 말했다. 앞서 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁이 발발하자 온라인상에 중동발 경제 위기에 대응하기 위해 정부가 달러를 강제로 매각하게 할 것이라는 내용의 허위 글이 확산했다.)

President Lee said, "Spreading false information that harms the public is neither freedom of expression nor a subject of tolerance." He added, "A prank? You call it a joke? Just as killing people and destroying the order and values of a community are serious crimes that must be severely punished even if done as a prank or joke, the same applies here." He continued, "I should send pizza to the hardworking police investigation team, shouldn’t I?" (이 대통령은 “공공에 피해를 입히는 허위사실 유포는 표현의 자유도 아니고, 포용의 대상도 아니다”라고 했다. 이어 “장난? 놀이라고요? 사람을 죽이고 공동체의 질서와 가치를 파괴하는 것은 장난이나 놀이로 했더라도 엄벌돼야 할 중대범죄인 것과 마찬가지”라며 “열일하는 경찰 수사팀에 피자라도 보내줘야겠지요?”라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam, wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee to Drug Offenders: "Don't Waste Money Going to Prison, Get Treatment Instead" (이 대통령, 마약 사범에 “돈 쓰면서 교도소가지 말고, 치료받길”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 2nd, addressing drug offenders, "Don't bother spending money to go to prison; I hope you seek treatment early." (이재명 대통령이 2일 마약류 사범들을 향해 “공연히 돈 쓰면서 교도소 가지 마시고, 일찍 치료받길 바란다”고 말했다.)

President Lee shared an article on X (formerly Twitter) stating that the government, which has been waging a 'war on drugs,' arrested 5,386 online drug offenders over the past 10 months and seized 3,233 kilograms of drugs at border stages, and made this remark. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 ‘마약과의 전쟁’ 벌인 정부가 10개월간 온라인 마약사범 5386명을 검거하고, 국경 단계에서 마약류 3233㎏를 적발했다는 기사를 공유하며 이렇게 밝혔다.)

President Lee said, "To all drug users, we have deployed drug enforcement agents to all domestic mail distribution centers to crack down on the social evil of drugs," and added, "Detection equipment such as the drug-sniffing dog 'Injo-ko' will also be installed." He continued, "If you purchase drugs by mail, you will definitely be caught and punished." (이 대통령은 “마약 투약 사범 여러분, 사회악인 마약 단속을 위해 모든 국내 우편집중국에 마약단속요원을 배치했다”며 “마약탐지견 ‘인조코’ 등 탐지장비도 설치한다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “우편으로 마약을 구입하면 반드시 적발돼 처벌된다”고 덧붙였다.)

Since December 29 of last year, the government has been piloting a 'double inspection' of drugs for mail destined for most areas of Seoul. It operates by having the Korea Customs Service conduct a first check at the customs screening stage, followed by a second inspection at mail distribution centers in cooperation between the Customs Service and the Korea Post. (정부는 지난해 12월29일부터 서울 대부분 지역으로 배송되는 우편물 대상 마약류 ‘이중검사’를 시범 실시하고 있다. 관세청이 세관 심사 단계에서 1차로 점검하고, 우편집중국에서 관세청과 우정사업본부가 협력해 2차 검사를 실시하는 방식으로 진행하고 있다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Was King Danjong deposed for meddling in state affairs?"... A rebuke to Park Geun-hye's claim of 'restoration' (“단종이 국정 농단해 폐위됐나”…박근혜 ‘복위’ 주장에 일침)
item.description:
When Rep. Yoo Young-ha of the People Power Party argued about former President Park Geun-hye, saying, "Just like King Danjong, who was restored from his position as Prince Nosan, the yoke falsely placed by lies and slander will surely be removed and she will be restored to her rightful place," Rep. Son Sol of the Progressive Party strongly criticized, asking, "Are you saying that King Danjong was deposed for meddling in state affairs?" (유영하 국민의힘 의원이 박근혜 전 대통령을 두고 “노산군에서 복위된 단종처럼 거짓과 모함으로 덧씌워진 멍에는 반드시 벗겨지고 제 자리로 복위될 것”이라고 주장하자, 손솔 진보당 의원은 “단종이 국정농단 해서 폐위됐단 말이냐”며 강하게 비판했다.)

In a statement released on the 1st, Rep. Sohn described Rep. Yoo's claim as "an absurd and nonsensical rant," calling it "a bizarre sophistry not even worth refuting and a serious distortion of history." This was because Rep. Yoo compared the former President Park, who was impeached and removed from office in 2017, to "King Danjong, the tragic figure of history, and talked about restoration." (손 의원은 1일 서명 브리핑을 내어 유 의원의 주장을 “황당무계한 망언”, “논박할 가치조차 없는 해괴한 궤변이자 심각한 역사 왜곡”이라고 말했다. 2017년 대통령직에서 탄핵당한 박 전 대통령을 “역사 속 비극의 주인공인 단종에 비유하며 복위를 운운”했다는 이유에서다.)

Rep. Son asked Rep. Yoo, "When did King Danjong ever meddle in state affairs?" and "Do you mean that King Danjong privatized power and handed the country over to an unofficial confidant like Choi Soon-sil, leading to his deposition?" (손 의원은 유 의원에게 “단종이 언제 국정농단을 저지른 것이 있나”라며 “단종이 권력을 사유화하고 최순실 같은 비선 실세에게 나라를 넘겨서 폐위됐단 뜻이냐”고 물었다.)

Previously, former President Park was convicted by the Supreme Court for charges including meddling in state affairs with an unofficial confidant and receiving special activity funds from the National Intelligence Service, receiving a 22-year prison sentence, an 180 billion won fine, and a 35 billion won forfeiture. She served 4 years and 9 months before being released in December 2021 through a special pardon by former President Moon Jae-in. However, on that day, Rep. Yoo posted on Facebook comparing former President Park to King Danjong, who lost his throne to his uncle King Sejo and died at a young age, claiming that the 'restoration' of former President Park was "my last remaining calling." He also said, "The price for your public humiliation and the cruel dance of knives, the character assassination you committed, will surely be paid, and that day is not far off." <<> In response, Rep. Son stated, "It is pitiful and even pathetic to see a lawmaker who should uphold the constitution acting as a 'bodyguard' for the forces behind the state affairs meddling, indulging in blind loyalty," and demanded, "Stop this tear-jerking melodrama and absurd historical distortion that mocks the people, and apologize to the public for your sophistry." Regarding former President Park, he emphasized, "She is a state affairs meddling criminal and can never be restored to power." <<> He added, "The main figure who led the intense investigation and sought heavy sentences for Park Geun-hye at the time was Yoon Seok-yeol, and his inner circle now controls the People Power Party," and "If you want to complain about the 'cruel dance of knives' and 'character assassination' against Park Geun-hye, go take it up with the 'Yoon Again' leadership of the People Power Party." <<> Meanwhile, Rep. Choo Kyung-ho, the People Power Party candidate for Daegu Mayor, who had campaigned with former President Park's support, said in an interview with SBS Radio's 'Kim Tae-hyun's Political Show' on the 2nd, when asked about Rep. Yoo's 'King Danjong' comments, "The underlying sentiment among the people of Daegu and many citizens is that the former president has suffered a great injustice, and this feeling is widespread," and "There are quite a few citizens who sympathize with that sentiment." <<> Rep. Kim Jae-won, a supreme council member of the People Power Party, also said in an interview with CBS Radio's 'Park Seong-tae's News Show' on the same day, "It is true that many people are of the opinion that we should restore former President Park's honor," and "The fact that many people cheer and welcome former President Park (at campaign sites) suggests that the foundation for restoring her honor has already been laid." <<> Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (앞서 박 전 대통령은 비선 실세 국정농단 사건과 국가정보원 특수활동비 상납 등의 혐의로 징역 22년과 벌금 180억원, 추징금 35억원이 대법원에서 확정돼 4년9개월간 복역하다가 문재인 전 대통령의 특별사면으로 2021년 12월 풀려난 바 있다. 그런데 유 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 박 전 대통령을 삼촌 세조에게 왕위를 빼앗기고 어린 나이에 죽음을 맞은 단종에 비유하며 박 전 대통령의 ‘복위’가 “내게 마지막 남은 소명”이라고 말했다. “그대들이 했던 조리돌림과 잔인한 칼춤을 추면서 자행했던 인격 살인에 대한 대가는 꼭 받을 것이고, 그날이 멀지 않았다”고도 했다.)

item.title: President Lee on Hanwha Aerospace Disaster: "Report Recurring Accident Sites Separately" (이 대통령, 한화에어로 참사에 “반복 사고 사업장 따로 보고하라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 2nd regarding the explosion accident at Hanwha Aerospace's Daejeon plant on the 1st, "Relevant authorities should thoroughly investigate the cause of the accident and ensure thorough preventative measures are established." (이재명 대통령이 지난 1일 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장에서 발생한 폭발 사고와 관련해 “관계당국이 사고원인을 철저하게 조사하고, 재발방지대책 수립에도 만전을 기해야 한다”고 2일 말했다.)

President Lee said during a combined Cabinet meeting and emergency economic assessment meeting held at the Blue House on the same day, "Another explosion occurred at the Hanwha plant in Daejeon, resulting in casualties," and "I extend my condolences to those who lost their lives and hope for a swift recovery for the injured." Furthermore, President Lee instructed the Ministry of Employment and Labor, "Please expedite safety inspections at similar workplaces," and "In particular, it is a serious issue when accidents of the same type recur within the same workplace. Select workplaces where the same type of accident has repeatedly and continuously occurred and report them separately." <<> This marks the third explosion accident at Hanwha Aerospace's Daejeon plant, with a total of 13 deaths. In May 2018, an explosion occurred at a facility charging solid fuel for rockets, torpedoes, and shells, killing five and injuring four; in February 2019, another explosion led to a fire, claiming the lives of three workers. <<> President Lee remarked, "The workplace one goes to earn a living often becomes a site of death," and "There are times when I question whether our society truly respects and values human life enough." He continued, "Do we respect the lives of others as much as our own? Each individual life is a universe in itself, and there are times when I wonder if it is treated with equal dignity." <<> Reporters: Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr, Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의에서 “대전의 한화 공장에서 폭발 사고가 일어나 또 인명피해가 발생했다”며 “유명을 달리한 분들에 대한 명복을 빌고, 부상자들에 대한 빠른 쾌유를 기원한다”고 말했다. 그러면서 이 대통령은 “다른 유사사업장에 대해서도 안전점검을 서둘러 달라”며 “특히 동일한 사업장 안에서 동일한 유형의 사고가 발생하는 것은 심각한 문제다. 사업장 안에서 동일한 유형의 사고가 반복적으로 지속적으로 발생한 사업장을 추려서 따로 보고해달라”고 고용노동부에 지시했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon Takes Off the Red Vest… "The Last Bastion, Please Leave Seoul to Us" (빨간 조끼 벗은 오세훈…“최후의 보루, 서울만은 남겨달라”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, on the final day of official campaigning for the June 3 local elections, said, "The opposition has failed to represent the public sentiment sufficiently," adding, "Just because the opposition is at fault, we cannot abandon checks and balances," and pleaded, "The last bastion, please leave Seoul to us." (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 6·3 지방선거 공식선거운동 마지막날인 2일 “야당이 더 크게 민심을 대변하지 못했다”며 “야당에 잘못이 있다고 견제와 균형마저 포기할 수 없다”며 “최후의 보루, 서울만은 남겨 달라”고 호소했다.)

Speaking to reporters in front of Hyochang Park Station in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, Oh opened by saying, "Throughout the campaign period, I have sensed resignation and desperation, as if even diligent work offers no future. Before assigning blame, I first offer my apologies." He then stated, "If we lose checks and balances, the powerful have no reason to be humble or to listen to the people's voices. To protect the rule of law and freedom in this country, the counterweight is more crucial than ever, and that counterweight lies in the hands of Seoul citizens." (오 후보는 이날 서울 용산구 효창공원역 앞에서 기자들과 만나 “선거 기간 내내 성실하게 일해도 미래가 보이지 않는다는 체념과 절박함을 확인했다. 책임을 따지기에 앞서 죄송하다는 말씀을 먼저 드린다”고 입을 열었다. 그러면서 “(견제와 균형을 잃으면) 권력자가 겸손할 이유도, 국민 목소리를 경청할 이유도 함께 사라진다”며 “오직 이 나라 법치와 자유를 지키기 위해 그 어느 때보다 균형추가 중요하고, 균형추를 쥔 게 서울시민”이라고 말했다.)

Targeting Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh, he said, "The Seoul mayor is not a position that a candidate relying on the president's coattails can handle. Having stepped forward to manage a mega-city while evading scrutiny was absolutely unacceptable, and in that sense, he is an unprepared candidate who has lost his qualification. I urge him to drop out now." (그는 정원오 더불어민주당 후보를 겨냥해 “서울시장은 대통령 후광에 기댄 후보가 감당할 수 있는 자리가 아니다. 초거대도시를 경영하겠다고 나섰으면서 검증을 회피하면 절대 안 됐고, 그런 의미에서 자격을 상실한 준비 부족 후보”라며 “지금이라도 사퇴하라”고 했다.)

Regarding the current electoral landscape, Oh commented, "Combining various polls, the conclusion is that it's extremely close," and added, "I will give my all with the mindset of a challenger trailing by 3 to 5 percent until the very last moment." Taking off his red vest and revealing a white T-shirt with the phrase "Global Top 3," he said, "If I run hard for just four more years, I am confident we can enter the global top 3. I will campaign in this T-shirt for the final rally." (현재 판세에 대해 오 후보는 “여러 여론조사를 종합하면 결론은 초박빙”이라며 “마지막 순간까지 3∼5% 지고 있다는 도전자의 심정으로 사력을 다하겠다”고 했다. 오 후보는 빨간색 조끼를 벗고 ‘글로벌 탑(TOP) 3’이라는 문구가 적힌 흰 티셔츠를 내보이며 “4년만 더 열심히 뛰면 글로벌 탑3에 진입할 자신이 생겼다. 이 티셔츠를 입고 마지막 유세에 임하겠다”고 말했다.)

Oh plans to continue campaigning through Gyeongui Line Forest Park in Mapo-gu, Namdaemun Market in Jung-gu, Yeonsinnae Station Rodeo Street in Eunpyeong-gu, Hwagok Station in Gangseo-gu, Seoul National University Station in Gwanak-gu, Seongdae Market in Dongjak-gu, Namsung Sijang Market in Seocho-gu, and finally conclude with a rally in front of Sinchon Station in Seodaemun-gu. (오 후보는 이후 서울 마포구 경의선숲길, 중구 남대문시장, 은평구 연신내역 로데오거리, 강서구 화곡역, 관악구 서울대입구역, 동작구 성대시장, 서초구 남성사계시장 등을 거쳐 서대문구 신촌역 앞에서 유세를 할 예정이다.)

item.title: President Lee: "In the Second Year of My Term, I Will Create Greater Tangible Changes in the Lives of the People" (이 대통령 “임기 2년차, 국민 삶 실질적 변화 더 크게 만들 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 2nd, "We must focus on spreading the improvements in key indicators such as exports to all aspects of people's livelihoods, including small and medium-sized enterprises, small business owners, ordinary citizens, and vulnerable groups." (이재명 대통령이 2일 “수출 등 핵심지표 개선 성과를 중소기업, 소상공인, 서민, 취약계층 등 민생 전반으로 확산시키는 데 주력해야 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee made these remarks during a Cabinet meeting combined with an emergency economic review meeting held at Cheong Wa Dae on the same day, stating, "Starting from the second year of my term, which will soon begin, we must create larger tangible changes in the people's lives, accelerate the pace, and broaden the scope based on the policy achievements so far." President Lee added, "We must build a solid physical and institutional foundation to accelerate the AI revolution and energy transition, and spur the development of other high-tech industries such as robotics and defense, as well as semiconductors, to open wide the door to a global super-gap economic powerhouse." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의에서 “곧 시작될 임기 2년차부터는 지금까지 정책 성과를 바탕으로 국민 삶의 실질적 변화를 더 크게 만들고, 더 속도를 높이고, 더 폭을 넓혀가야겠다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “인공지능 혁명과 에너지 전환을 가속할 물적, 제도적 기반을 튼튼하게 만들고, 반도체뿐 아니라 로봇, 방산 등 여타 첨단산업 육성에도 박차를 가해서 글로벌 초격차 경제강국의 문도 활짝 열어가야겠다”고 말했다.)

According to data released by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy the previous day, May exports amounted to $87.75 billion, setting a record high on a monthly basis. President Lee appears to have emphasized that the improvements in macroeconomic indicators, such as increased exports, should not stop there but must spread to all aspects of people's livelihoods, including small and medium-sized enterprises, small business owners, and vulnerable groups. (산업통상부가 전날 발표한 5월 수출액은 877억5000만달러로, 월간 기준 역대 최대치를 기록했다. 이 대통령은 수출 증가 등 거시경제 지표 개선에 그치지 않고 그 성과가 중소기업과 소상공인, 취약계층 등 민생 전반으로 확산돼야 한다는 점을 강조한 것으로 보인다.)

President Lee also instructed all efforts to manage prices amid the prolonged wars in the US, Israel, and Iran. President Lee said, "The prolonged Middle East war has increased the burden of prices on the people," adding, "If the real income of vulnerable groups decreases due to price hikes, polarization will widen, and economic vitality will inevitably regress." President Lee continued, "For urgent stabilization of grocery prices, I ask each ministry to swiftly implement necessary measures, such as preemptively supplying government reserves, strengthening discount support, and further expanding allocated tariff quotas," and added, "Market disruptive behaviors like hoarding and collusion must be thoroughly investigated and strictly held accountable, so that companies feel they will go bankrupt if caught even once." (이 대통령은 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 장기화로 인한 물가 관리에도 총력을 다하라고 지시했다. 이 대통령은 “중동전쟁 장기화로 인해 국민들 물가 부담이 가중됐다”며 “물가상승으로 취약계층의 실질소득이 감소하면 양극화가 확대되고, 경제활력도 뒷걸음칠 수밖에 없다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “시급한 장바구니 물가 안정을 위해 정부 비축분을 선제공급하고, 할인 지원 강화, 할당 관세물량 추가 확대 등 필요한 대책을 각 부처에서 신속하게 추진해주길 바란다”며 “매점매석, 담합 같은 시장 교란 행위는 한번만 걸려도 회사가 망한다는 생각이 들도록 철저히 조사하고 엄히 책임을 물어야 한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Seoul City Revives Plan to Subsidize Oh Se-hoon's Han River Bus 'Deficit of 13.5 Billion Won' (서울시 돈으로 오세훈표 한강버스 ‘적자 135억’ 지원 재추진)
item.description:
Seoul City is pushing forward with a plan to provide 13.5 billion won in subsidies over two years to support the deficit-ridden operator of the Han River Bus. This is a revised version of a proposal that was voted down by the city council in April. The city explained that "the previously rejected agenda has been resubmitted as a revised plan, reflecting the council's opinions and reducing the scope of support." (서울시가 적자 상태인 한강버스 운영사에 2년간 135억원 규모의 적자를 지원하는 방안을 추진한다. 지난 4월 시의회에서 부결된 안을 일부 수정해 다시 내놓은 것인데, 서울시는 "부결됐던 안건을 의회 의견을 반영해 지원 범위를 축소한 수정안이 다시 상정된 것"이라고 해명헀다.)

Seoul City submitted the 'Proposal for Agreement on Changes to the Han River Bus Operation Business Agreement' to the city council on the 26th of last month. The city council is set to review the agenda during a regular meeting on the 10th. (서울시는 지난달 26일 ‘한강버스 운영사업 업무협약 변경 동의안’을 시의회에 제출했다. 시의회는 오는 10일 정례회에서 안건을 심의할 예정이다.)

The amount the city plans to pay is 8.287 billion won in 2027 and 5.255 billion won in 2028, totaling 13.5 billion won. The entire funding will come from the city's own budget. This amount largely involves retroactive support for losses already incurred in 2024–2025. According to the cost estimate report, the operating deficit (losses) was approximately 1.1 billion won in 2024 and about 7.2 billion won in 2025, with combined losses exceeding 8.3 billion won over just these two years. Seoul City plans to disburse this in 2027 through the 2026 budget formation process. (시가 지급하겠다는 금액은 2027년 82억8700만원, 2028년 52억5500만원으로 총 135억원이다. 재원은 전액 시비로 충당한다. 이 금액은 2024~2025년에 이미 발생한 손실분을 소급해 지원하는 성격이 강하다. 비용추계서를 보면, 운항결손액(적자)은 2024년 약 11억원, 2025년 약 72억원으로, 두 해에만 합산 83억원이 넘는 손실이 이미 발생해 있다. 서울시는 이를 2026년 예산 편성 과정을 거쳐 2027년에 지급하겠다는 방침이다.)

The key point of this revised agreement is changing the standard for applying labor costs when calculating the operating deficit. Previously, the agreement used the 'minimum crew size under the Seafarers Act' as the basis for manpower on board. Now it will be changed to 'the minimum crew size under the Ship Officers Act and additional safety personnel agreed upon with Seoul City,' thereby widening the scope of labor costs. This structure increases the operating deficit, which serves as the basis for calculating subsidies. (이번 동의안의 핵심은 운항결손액 산정 시 인건비 적용 기준을 바꾸는 것이다. 기존 협약에서 승선인력 기준으로 삼던 ‘선원법상 최소 승무정원’을 ‘선박직원법 등에 따른 최소 승무정원 및 서울시와 협의된 추가 안전인력’으로 변경해 인건비 적용 범위를 넓혔다. 이를 통해 보조금 산정 기준이 되는 운항결손액이 커지는 구조다.)

The biggest difference compared to the April proposal that was rejected is the removal of the free shuttle bus operation cost support item. However, the core structure of covering the operating deficit with public subsidies remains unchanged. (4월에 부결된 안과 비교하면 무료 셔틀버스 운영비 지원 항목이 빠진 것이 가장 큰 차이다. 하지만 운항결손액을 공공 보조금으로 메우는 핵심 구조는 그대로 유지됐다.)

The governance structure of the entity receiving support is also controversial. Han River Bus Co., Ltd., the operator, has a structure where the Seoul Housing and Communities Corporation (SH) holds a 51% stake and the private operator Eco Cruise holds 49%. This effectively means that public funds are being injected into a corporation majority-owned by a public institution, while the private operator indirectly benefits. According to the Financial Supervisory Service's disclosure standards, the cumulative operating loss of Han River Bus Co., Ltd. stands at 10.4 billion won, and its net loss for the period amounts to 16 billion won. (지원 대상 법인의 지배구조도 논란이다. 한강버스 운영사인 ㈜한강버스는 서울주택도시공사(SH)가 지분 51%를 보유하고 민간사업자 이크루즈가 49%를 갖는 구조다. 사실상 공공기관이 과반 출자한 법인에 시비를 투입하면서도, 민간사업자가 간접적으로 혜택을 받는 형태다. 금융감독원 공시 기준 주식회사 한강버스의 누적 영업손실은 104억원, 당기순손실은 160억원에 달한다.)

There is a view that the rosy projections for ancillary business revenues also require verification. According to the cost estimate report submitted by the city, it assumes achieving target advertising revenue of 1 billion to 1.4 billion won per month starting in 2027, making a shift to profitability possible by 2028. (‘장밋빛’ 부대사업 수익 추계도 검증이 필요하다는 시각이 있다. 시가 제출한 비용추계서에 따르면 2027년 이후 광고 수입만 월 10억~14억원 수준의 목표 매출을 달성한다는 전제 위에서 2028년 흑자 전환이 가능하다는 계산이 성립한다.)

In response, Seoul City stated, "This proposal respects the council's review opinions by significantly reducing the scope of support" and "it involves detailed adjustments to safety-related labor costs necessary for securing the statutory minimum crew and additional safety personnel to match actual operating conditions." It also emphasized, "The support for the operating deficit is being pursued based on a city council resolution under the ordinance enacted in 2024." (이에 대해 서울시는 “이번 안은 의회 검토의견을 존중해 지원 범위를 대폭 축소한 것”이라며 “법정 승무정원 및 추가 안전인력 확보에 필요한 안전 관련 인건비를 실제 운항 여건에 맞게 세부 조정한 사항”이라고 밝혔다. 또 “2024년 제정된 조례의 시의회 의결을 근거로 운항결손액 지원이 추진되는 것”이라고 강조했다.)

Reporter Shin Hyeong-cheol newiron@hani.co.kr (신형철 기자 newiron@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ROK-U.S. Security Talks Begin... Likely to Outline Agenda for Working-Level Consultations on Nuclear Energy, Nuclear Submarines, and Shipbuilding (한미 안보협상 시작…원자력·핵잠·조선 실무 협의 의제 정리할 듯)
item.description:
Security sector negotiations, agreed upon during the ROK-U.S. summit, began on the 2nd. More than six months after the release of the Joint Fact Sheet (JFS), a follow-up joint explanatory document from the November summit, the two sides have taken the first steps in negotiations to secure rights for uranium enrichment and reprocessing of spent nuclear fuel, acquire nuclear-powered submarines, and collaborate in the shipbuilding industry. (한국과 미국의 정상회담 합의 사항인 안보 분야 협상이 2일 시작됐다. 지난해 11월 한-미 정상회담 후속 공동 설명자료인 조인트 팩트시트(JFS)를 발표한 뒤 6개월여 만에 우라늄 농축과 사용후핵연료 재처리 권한 확보, 핵추진잠수함(핵잠) 도입, 조선업 분야 협상의 첫발을 뗀 것이다.)

ROK and U.S. officials kicked off the inaugural meeting for follow-up security measures at 10 a.m. on this day at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs building in Jongno-gu, Seoul. First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo of South Korea and U.S. Acting Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs Allison Hooker co-chaired the first meeting, followed by sector-specific discussions. (한·미는 이날 오전 10시 서울 종로구 외교부 청사에서 안보 분야 후속 조처 협의를 위한 발족 회의를 시작했다. 한국 수석대표인 박윤주 외교부 1차관과 미국 쪽 수석대표인 앨리슨 후커 국무부 정무차관이 첫 회의를 주재하고, 이후 분야별 협의를 진행한다.)

The U.S. side includes participants from the White House, State Department, Department of Energy, and Department of Defense. The meeting was attended by Deputy Assistant Secretary of State for East Asian and Pacific Affairs David W. Stilwell, Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary of State for Arms Control and Nonproliferation Christopher Klein, Senior Director for East Asia at the White House National Security Council (NSC) Ivan Kanapathy, Deputy Administrator of the National Nuclear Security Administration at the Department of Energy Matthew Naples, and U.S. Chargé d'Affaires ad interim James H. Hele. The South Korean government is represented by the National Security Office at the presidential office, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of National Defense, Ministry of Climate and Energy (likely meaning Ministry of Environment), Ministry of Science and ICT, Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, and Nuclear Safety and Security Commission. When entering the building, journalists asked Acting Under Secretary Hooker whether the U.S. is open to revising or creating a new nuclear agreement or nuclear submarine agreement, and whether a conclusion could be reached by the end of the year, but she did not respond. (미국 쪽에선 백악관과 국무부, 에너지부, 전쟁부 등에서 협상에 참여한다. 이날 회의엔 후커 차관을 비롯해 데이비드 와일레즐 국무부 동아태 부차관보, 크리스토퍼 클레인 국무부 군축 및 비확산 부차관보 대리, 아이번 캐너패시 백악관 국가안보회의(NSC) 동아시아 담당 수석국장, 매슈 나폴리 에너지부 국가핵안보청 부청장, 제임스 헬러 주한미국대사대리 등이 참석한 것으로 파악됐다. 우리 정부에선 청와대 국가안보실과 외교부, 국방부, 기후에너지부, 과학기술정보통신부, 산업통상부, 원자력안전위원회 등에서 협상에 나선다. 후커 차관은 이날 청사로 들어오면서 기자들이 ‘미국은 원자력 협정과 핵잠 협정 개정 또는 창설에 열려있는지’ ‘연말까지 결론이 나올지’ 등을 질문했으나 답하지 않았다.)

In today's meeting, it is expected that the two sides will identify each other's desired negotiation conditions and content in areas such as nuclear energy, nuclear submarines, and shipbuilding cooperation, and outline a specific negotiation agenda. Given that the start of negotiations came later than initially anticipated, both countries share the recognition that they need to immediately dive into working-level consultations. The South Korean government, which seeks independent uranium enrichment and reprocessing, emphasizes the peaceful use of nuclear energy and focuses on alleviating U.S. concerns about the potential for nuclear proliferation. The construction of nuclear submarines and the supply of fuel are also key issues under bilateral discussion. (이날 회의에선 원자력 협상과 핵잠, 조선업 협력 등 각 분야에서 한·미가 원하는 협상 조건과 내용을 서로 파악하고, 구체적인 협상 의제를 정리할 것으로 보인다. 협상 시작 시점이 당초 예상보다 늦어진 만큼, 실무적 협의에 바로 돌입해야 한다는 게 양국 공통의 인식이다. 자체 우라늄 농축과 재처리를 원하는 우리 정부는 원자력의 평화적 이용 목적을 강조하며 핵확산 가능성 등에 대한 미국의 우려를 불식하는 데 주안점을 두고 있다. 핵잠 건조와 연료 공급 방식을 둘러싼 양국 협의도 주요 현안이다.)

ROK and U.S. officials plan to conclude the first kickoff meeting in Seoul by the 3rd and then proceed with additional rounds of talks, including a second and third round. The meetings are expected to alternate between Seoul and Washington, D.C. (한·미는 3일까지 서울에서 1차 킥오프 회의를 마친 뒤 차후 2·3차 등 추가 협상을 진행할 계획이다. 회의는 서울과 미국 워싱턴에서 번갈아 진행될 전망이다.)

item.title: President Lee: "If you can't repay a debt, discharge is common sense... No one should die from personal debt" (이 대통령 “빚 못 갚으면 면책이 상식…개인부채로 죽는 일 없어야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 2nd, "We need to systematically investigate and manage personal debts. It’s a massive social problem." (이재명 대통령이 2일 “개인 부채 등에 대해서 체계적으로 조사하고 관리해야 한다. 엄청난 사회적 문제”라고 말했다.)

During a Cabinet meeting combined with an emergency economic review held at the Blue House that day, President Lee stated, "Cases that turn extreme are more likely tied to personal debt rather than institutional debt," and "Our society is too harsh. In which country in the world do people die because of debt?" He added, "We need to prevent reports of family-group suicides. What kind of primitive society is this? Shouldn’t we investigate or create a special body to uncover these issues?" He continued, "We must ensure no one says they die because of debt. It seems to me this issue has been neglected." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의에서 “극단적으로 몰리는 경우가 금융기관 부채보다는 개인 부채일 가능성이 높다”, “우리 사회가 너무 가혹해서 그렇다. 세상 어느 나라에서 빚 때문에 죽는다고 하냐”며 이렇게 말했다.)

President Lee argued that if people cannot repay their debts, they should be actively informed about filing for personal bankruptcy to obtain discharge. He said, "The cause of debt isn’t always the debtor’s fault. Creditors should lend after considering the borrower’s ability to repay. It’s common sense: if you can’t repay the debt, you get discharged. But the media talks about moral hazard and emphasizes that if you owe money, you must repay it until you die." (이 대통령은 이어 “일가족 집단 자살 얘기가 나오는데, 이런 원시적 사회가 어딨냐. 특별한 기구를 만들든지 조사를 하든지 해서 찾아내야 하는 거 아니냐”며 “빚 때문에 죽는다, 이런 소리가 안 나오게 해야 한다. 내가 보니 (이 문제가) 방치돼 있는 것 같다”고 말했다.)

He then said, "What fool would default with the ability to pay while being unable to get a job, live a normal life, and be credit-impaired?" He noted that "not knowing about the personal bankruptcy discharge system and ultimately dying, or being unable to engage in economic activities for a long time, is a loss." The personal bankruptcy discharge system allows individuals who lack the ability to repay debts to have their obligation to repay remaining debts forgiven after a court review. (이 대통령은 빚을 갚지 못하면 개인파산을 신청해 면책받는 방법을 적극 알려야 한다고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “빚을 지는 원인은 채무자가 잘못한 것도 있지만, 채권자가 (갚을 능력을) 고려해 빌려줘야 한다”며 “빚을 못 갚으면 면책하는 게 상식인데, 언론도 도덕적 해이를 얘기하고 빚지면 죽을 때까지 갚아야 한다는 걸 강조한다”고 말했다.

그러면서 이 대통령은 “어떤 바보가 신용 불량에 취직도 못 하고 일상생활 못하면서 능력 되면서 돈을 떼어먹겠냐”며 “(개인파산 면책) 제도를 모르고 결국 죽고, 오랜 시간 경제활동 못하는 건 손실”이라고 말했다. 개인파산 면책제도는 채무를 갚을 능력이 없는 사람이 법원 심사를 거쳐 남은 채무에 대한 변제 의무를 면제받는 제도다.)

Reporters: Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Won-oh: "I'm the 'One Team' with the Lee Jae-myung Government... Oh Se-hoon's Black Propaganda Will Face Judicial Judgment" (정원오 “이재명 정부와 ‘원 팀’은 나…오세훈 흑색비방, 사법심판 받을 것”)
item.description:
On June 2, the last day of the official campaign for the June 3 local elections, Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, appealed for votes and support, stating, "Only when Jung Won-oh and the Democratic Party district office candidates are elected together can the Lee Jae-myung government and Seoul move as one team." (6·3 지방선거 공식선거운동 마지막날인 2일, 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보는 “정원오와 민주당 구청장 후보들이 함께 당선되어야 이재명 정부와 서울이 원팀으로 움직일 수 있다”며 투표와 지지를 호소했다.)

The candidate held a press conference at the National Assembly with 25 district office candidates and said, "Tomorrow's election is not simply about electing one Seoul mayor. It is an election to empower the Lee Jae-myung government." He added, "If you don't vote tomorrow, we cannot win. We must vote until the end to win," and urged, "Let Seoul support the protection of the people's livelihoods and enable South Korea to take another leap forward." (정 후보는 이날 국회에서 25개 구청장 후보들과 함께 기자회견을 열고 “내일 선거는 단순히 서울시장 한 사람을 뽑는 선거가 아니다. 이재명 정부에 힘을 싣는 선거”라며 이렇게 말했다. 정 후보는 “내일 투표하지 않으면 이길 수 없다. 끝까지 투표해야 이긴다”며 “국민의 삶을 지키고, 대한민국이 다시 도약할 수 있도록 서울이 함께 뒷받침하게 해달라”고 말했다.)

In response to People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon demanding his withdrawal, calling him "unqualified" on the same day, Jung said, "It seems he intends to finish the election with negative black propaganda until the end. As I've said repeatedly, it's not that we don't have things to criticize about Candidate Oh; we just chose not to engage in negativity." He added, "Despite Candidate Oh saying that if we stop slander and negativity, policy-oriented campaigning would begin, it has been reported through the media that while he requested policy-focused campaigns on one hand, he systematically organized indiscriminate black propaganda through a comment room operation on the other. That part will not escape judicial judgment." (정 후보는 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 이날 “자격 미달”이라며 사퇴를 촉구한 데 대해 “역시 끝까지 네거티브 흑색비방으로 선거를 마무리하려는 것 같다”며 “누누이 말했지만 저희가 오 후보를 비방할 게 없어서 (네거티브를) 안한 게 아니다”라고 말했다. 이어 “(오 후보는) 비방과 네거티브를 중단하면 정책선거가 시작된다고 말했음에도 불구하고, 한쪽으로는 정책선거를 요청하면서 한쪽에서는 댓글방 운영을 통해 무분별한 흑색비방을 조직적으로 전개했다는 점이 언론을 통해 알려졌다”며 “그런 부분에 대한 사법적 심판도 피할 수 없을 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding Candidate Oh's demand for answers on the "Five Allegations"—including responsibility for administrative failures related to the delayed completion of the Haengdang 7 district project, suspicions of no-bid contracts with Seongdong-gu Office by companies led by major donors, and the circumstances of the Cancun business trip and accompanying employees' promotions—Jung said, "This is a typical negative campaign that rehashes and recycles answers already given multiple times, creating suspicions upon suspicions. I believe citizens see through this attempt to overturn the race because the election landscape is unfavorable." (오 후보가 △행당7구역 준공 지연 관련 행정 실패 책임 △고액 후원자가 대표인 업체들의 성동구청 수의계약 의혹 △칸쿤 출장 및 동행 직원 승진 경위 등 ‘5대 의혹’에 대한 답변을 요구한 데 대해서는 “이미 수차례 답변한 걸 재탕, 삼탕 해가며 의혹에 의혹을 만드는 전형적 네거티브 선거”라며 “선거판이 불리하니 어떻게든 뒤집어보려는 걸 시민들이 꿰뚫어보고 계시다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Go Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)
